definitions.explanation: A professional with technical expertise in a specialized field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧{技師|ぎし}だ。
{技師|ぎし}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。

⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{壊|こわ}れた→壊れる：00791_kowareru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、{技師|ぎし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}んで→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦{直|なお}して→直す：00869_naosu⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: The factory machine broke down, so we called an engineer to fix it.

notes:
{技師|ぎし} refers to engineers and technicians.

TYPES OF ENGINEERS:
- {電気|でんき}{技師|ぎし} (electrical engineer)
- {機械|きかい}{技師|ぎし} (mechanical engineer)
- {土木|どぼく}{技師|ぎし} (civil engineer)
- {放射線|ほうしゃせん}{技師|ぎし} (radiological technician)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {技師|ぎし}: engineer/technician (formal, professional title)
- エンジニア: engineer (more common, from English)
- {技術者|ぎじゅつしゃ}: technical person, engineer
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}{者|しゃ}: technician
